email.subject: Quick fix for Peak Works Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I looked at the Peak Works Fitness site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so anyone searching on their phone has to copy and dial your number manually, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people can't tell if you're open before they drive over. The page is also slow from large, uncompressed images, and the title tag doesn't mention Harbor Falls or fitness, which hurts how you show up in search.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's going on - no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
